------------------------------------------------------------------------
"By 'feelings of inferiority' we mean not only inferiority feelings in
the strictest sense but a whole spectrum of related traits: low self-
esteem, feelings of powerlessness, depressive tendencies, defeatism,
guilt, self-hatred, etc.  We argue that modern leftists tend to have
such feelings (possibly more or less repressed) and that these feelings
are decisive in determining the direction of modern leftism."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 10
